_note: OpenAI Realtime function tools. Sent in session.update when a call's websocket opens (see scripts/spike_bridge.py). The model emits response.function_call_arguments.done; the bridge calls the matching Python function IN-PROCESS and replies with conversation.item.create / function_call_output. No HTTP webhooks, no dashboard, no URLs to rewrite.

tools.name: record_preferences
tools.description: Call this as soon as the caller has described what they're looking for - bedrooms, neighbourhoods, budget, parking, pets. Call it AGAIN any time they change or reprioritize what matters. Do not wait until the end of the conversation.

areas.description: Neighbourhoods, e.g. King West, Liberty Village.

priority_order.description: What matters most FIRST, e.g. [transit, price, parking]. Update whenever they reprioritize - this drives the re-rank.

tools.name: start_calls
tools.description: Call this when the caller has confirmed which listings they want verified, or when they give a number to call as the listing agent (e.g. +111111111111). BEFORE calling it, always ask whether there is anything else they want asked on the call. The moment you call it, say: 'Wait until I gather all the information from the real estate agents.' Then stay silent until it returns and read the speak field. Do not guess results.

listing_ids.description: Listings to verify, e.g. [L061, L003], or the listing-agent number +111111111111.

extra_questions.description: Anything extra the caller asked us to find out.

availability.description: When the renter can view, as one short phrase, e.g. weeknights after 6 or Saturday morning. Empty if they did not say.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Text the caller the shortlist link. Call this immediately at the start of the inbound call, before waiting for preferences, and again if they ask for the link or say they did not get it.

caller_phone.description: Caller's mobile in E.164, e.g. +14165551234. Omit if already known.

tools.name: book_viewing
tools.description: Call this when the caller confirms or rejects a viewing. decision is confirm or reject. That texts the listing agent either way.

listing_id.description: Listing to book or pass on.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: LISTING-AGENT SIDE ONLY. Call this at the end of the call with everything the listing agent told you. Only fill a field if they actually said it - omit it otherwise. Never guess: the entire product rests on these facts having come from a human.

addons.description: Mandatory extra costs, e.g. parking $180, locker $40.

pets_allowed.description: Exactly what they said about pets.

answers.description: Answers to the caller's extra questions.

source.description: Who said it and when, e.g. Mark, 1:42pm.
